subject: Fixes redhat-linux-build for build failure (#85)
reason: The change is a build fix: it only swaps printf format specifiers (%llx->%lx, %llu->%lu) in two ValkeyModule_Log/LogIOError calls in dom.cc and keytable.cc so the module compiles on redhat-linux. On LP64 Linux uint64_t is unsigned long, so the logged values are unchanged; the affected lines write only server log text (an invalid-RDB-metadata error and a keytable resize notice) and never touch command replies, stored JSON data, RDB payload bytes, or replication. There is no externally observable behaviour difference between the two builds to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
